model: COMPU25 Heat Pump Controller - BACnet Web Portal (legacy)
equipment_type: Modular heat pump chiller controller gateway
applies_to: Multistack modular water-to-water heat pump chillers with the COMPU25 master controller and the Multistack BACnet web portal (MS20/30/50 heat pump application).
summary: This is the heat pump version of the Multistack web portal, a gateway that reads a COMPU25 master controller over RS-232 and serves its data as BACnet IP Analog and Binary Values. Compared with the chiller version it adds separate cooling and heating setpoints, an operating mode command, load-side and source-side water temperatures, cooling and heating run-hour bands and a heat delay. Points exist for 24 compressors. This is a legacy product; the manual is dated January 2008.
notes: Legacy product (January 2008 manual). This copy is hosted by a third party (Chipkin), not on a Multistack site.
Points exist for 24 compressors; AV 3 reports how many are installed, and points for absent compressors do not apply.
Write points (AV 184-197, AV 200, BV 34) are write-only; read values back from the matching read points.

The manual's prose numbers # OF COMPRESSORS, CAPACITY and DEMAND as AV 1-3; Table 3 puts them at AV 3, AV 1 and AV 2. This list follows Table 3 (its reference names match the objects); confirm with a device discovery.
Table 3 marks AV 198 MOST CURRENT FAULT as W, though it is described as a status value.
Temperatures follow the manual's degrees F; the table itself prints no units.

source.title: Multistack BACnet Portal Technical Manual - MS20/30/50 Heat Pump Application, BACnet over TCP/IP

integration.summary: Connect the portal's 10BaseT port to the BACnet IP network and discover device 610001. Start and stop the unit with BV 34 and set the mode with AV 197, then check BV 1 and AV 5 for the real state. Write the cooling or heating upper/lower setpoints and the load limit, and supervise with the load and source water temperatures and fault points.

minimum_points.name: cool_upsetpt_write_1
minimum_points.why: Cooling upper setpoint (entering water at full load)

minimum_points.name: cool_lowsetpt_write_1
minimum_points.why: Cooling lower setpoint (leaving water at full load)

integration.enable: BV 34 ON/OFF CONTROL turns the unit on (1) or off (0) and should stay on while the BAS wants it running. The hard-wired EX2 input on the COMPU25 must also be closed; its state shows on BV 3. Multistack also suggests a BAS dry contact on EX2 as an alternative to the network command.
setup: Default device instance 610001; changing it needs Multistack.
Default IP 192.168.1.101, mask 255.255.255.0, gateway 0.0.0.0, BACnet IP network number 6100.
BACnet IP only, over a 10 Mbps 10BaseT port; the BAS side supplies the CAT5 cable.
Portal-to-COMPU25 link is RS-232 at 2400 baud, 8N1, fixed; 50 ft maximum.
Addressing DIP switches: 3 and 4 ON, 1, 2 and 5 OFF.
gotchas: BV 34 has the same priority as the keypad. If someone stops the unit locally, BV 1 goes off while BV 34 stays on; write BV 34 off briefly, then on, to restart.
Write points are write-only; read current values from the separate read points.
Fault codes (FAULTS C1-C24, FAULT 1-20 TYPE) are numbers decoded with the manual's fault tables.
Most system faults need a reset at the COMPU25 before the unit restarts.
